RUBY_VERSION.description: Specific version of ruby to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

RUBY_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for ruby: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

GEM_OFFLINE.description: Flag (0 or 1) directing gem to install packages only from local archives.

BUNDLE_LOCAL.description: Flag ('true' or 'false') instructing Bundler to run in local offline mode without remote queries.

RUBY_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading ruby binary or archive artifacts.

RUBY_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying ruby available remote releases.
